effect.sun-moon: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

short_effect.sun-moon: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
